title: One deterministic capital guard for every risk-increasing action

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 1. One capital_guard module is the only place that authorizes risk-increasing actions; pool activation/status change, binding activation and rebalance apply call it
acceptance_criteria.verification: services/capital/capital_guard.py CapitalGuard.authorize; called from update_pool_status (only when moving to active), activate_binding and the first-commit branch of apply_rebalance (only when a line increases weight, so exact replays stay readable). test_routes_call_guard_for_pool_binding_and_rebalance.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 2. Valid governance approval for exactly this action via ApprovalEvidence.require_valid, two distinct deciders for live increases
acceptance_criteria.verification: Guard reads the exact decision and calls require_valid(expected=tenant_id,target_type,target_id and subject.* incl. risk_direction=increase). For capital_binding_activation and rebalance_apply, approval_targets.required_deciders demands two distinct deciders on increases. Two-decider logic itself lives in governance and is covered there; this task asserts the guard passes the expected binding (test_allows_when_every_check_passes_and_binds_exact_action). Rebalance apply reuses the existing approval_ref field as the governance decision id.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 3. Reject risk increases while kill switch or safe mode is active; fail closed if unreadable
acceptance_criteria.verification: Safe-mode state read from the runtime manager GET /api/kill-switch/{pool}/safe-mode; only normal/normal_restored pass. test_rejects_while_safe_mode_or_kill_switch_active, test_fails_closed_when_safe_mode_unreadable, test_binding_activation_and_apply_blocked_by_safe_mode.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 4. Run existing risk_policy limits and the tenant check
acceptance_criteria.verification: RiskPolicyEvaluator.evaluate per increasing line; missing/unloadable policy fails closed; tenant must be non-empty and equal the pool tenant. test_risk_policy_limits_reject, test_fails_closed_when_risk_policy_missing, test_rejects_missing_or_foreign_tenant.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 5. Containment stays decrease-only without approval and still requires evidence and audit
acceptance_criteria.verification: Containment path untouched apart from removing the unused approval fields; existing decrease-only, evidence_refs and audit-delivery tests in test_service.py still pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 6. String-only approval_ref and two_man_signature_id checks deleted
acceptance_criteria.verification: Removed the increases_live/approval_ref truthiness check from allocation_store.apply_rebalance and the approval_ref/two_man_signature_id fields from the containment request/response models and record.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 7. Tests cover each rule and every fail-closed path

limitations: No integration test against a live governance service or runtime manager; both are faked at the reader seam.
Risk policy source is CAPITAL_RISK_POLICY_DIR/<risk_policy_ref>.json; no other capital-side policy store exists, so unconfigured deployments reject every increase (fail closed).
services/capital/conftest.py supplies healthy fakes by default so pre-existing service tests run; guard tests pass explicit fakes.

Pool activation uses governance target capital_pool_activation (two deciders); it supplies no stage fact, so a policy with allowed_stages rejects pool activation (fail closed). Factors with no capital-side source (sector, factor, strategy-family concentration, overlap, correlation) reject when the policy configures them.

items.1: create_pool authorizes active creation via _authorize_pool_activation before persistence; CreateCapitalPoolRequest.approval_decision_id; test_active_pool_create_is_guarded_before_persistence
items.2: Governance target capital_pool_activation (models, approval_decision.py, schema, approval_targets subject + 2 deciders); test_pool_activation_proposal_and_exact_approval builds a real ProposeApprovalRequest
items.3: target_version = owner-computed pool_digest/binding_digest, exposed as approval_digest on the pool/binding bodies; test_binding_activation_binds_semantic_digest_and_policy_facts
items.4: guard contexts carry binding scope as stage and rebalance plan facts (weights, gross, net, leverage, turnover); a configured limit with no observation is rejected; test_configured_limit_without_observation_fails_closed
items.5: plan_digest is computed from stored normalized lines (allocation_line_digest), exposed on RebalanceBody and compared at apply; request_hash only keeps idempotency; test_rebalance_approval_binds_owner_plan_digest_not_request_hash
items.6: CAPITAL_RISK_POLICY_DIR now defaults to services/capital/risk_policies; Compose reader/runtime-manager wiring deliberately left to BFF-APPROVALS-FORWARD-001 per task note (hosted acceptance is paired delivery); conftest seam now validates a real ApprovalEvidence

verification_run: pytest services/capital + governance approval tests: 220 passed, 1 skipped

items.1: CapitalGuard derives required observations from every configured RiskPolicy limit (zero-valued included); pool and binding activation supply the authoritative pool snapshot (_pool_facts); sector/factor limits with no source reject
items.2: _pool_facts overlays plan lines on all authoritative tenant/pool allocations under the apply lock; test_rebalance_limits_include_unchanged_allocations
items.note: An empty pool legitimately observes gross 0, so activation with gross_limit>0 passes; pre-existing allocations over the limit reject (test_pool_activation_sees_existing_allocations).
